answer_1.quote: We also define and train generative models, called EntailmentWriters, for this task, adapting earlier techniques for generating deductive proofs.

answer_2.quote: We use the F1/BLEURT metrics score elements of the tree (micro-averaging the results), while 'AllCorrect' checks if all the elements are correct.

answer_4.quote: Human judgements estimated Overall AllCorrect at 58% (vs. 35.6% comparing with the gold tree), suggesting the automated evaluation is underestimating true task performance.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to assess whether the generated entailment tree was completely correct (overall correctness).
